verdict: Paid leads are flowing at healthy cost, but organic and local channels are underused.
diagnosis: This period brought 298 leads at roughly $27 each on $7,915 spend — competitive versus legal norms, but Instagram engagement stayed flat.

signals.headline: 298 leads generated this period
signals.detail: Meta lead ads produced 298 form submissions on $7,915 spend, averaging roughly $27 per lead.

signals.headline: 5 new 5-star reviews this period
signals.detail: Reputation stays perfect at 5.0 stars across 770 reviews. Reviews are a real competitive moat here.

signals.headline: Only 122 call clicks this period
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 122 calls but zero direction requests. Local intent is phone-first, not visit-first.

signals.headline: Instagram grew by 2 followers
signals.detail: Followers sit at 31 with 20 profile visits. Organic social is not yet a meaningful lead channel.

signals.headline: 1,521 landing page views this period
signals.detail: Of 2,209 link clicks, 1,521 loaded the page. Roughly 20% drop-off between click and view.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Legal lead ads run $21–$56 per lead
benchmark.body: Meta lead ad benchmarks for law firms sit near $21 in 2026, with the broader legal category averaging $56 recently. Justice Consumer Law's ~$27 per lead is in the healthy zone.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Late summer legal search stays steady
seasonal.body: Consumer debt and collection queries hold steady through August. Back-to-school budget stress typically lifts debt-related inquiries in September, so demand should firm up next month.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Firms shifting budget to Meta lead ads
competitor.body: More consumer law firms are moving spend from Google Ads to Meta lead forms as Google legal clicks stay expensive. Video creative and review-driven ads are winning the auction.

recommendations.title: Test a Spanish-language lead ad variant
recommendations.detail: Search Console shows Spanish queries like "mis derechos como consumidor" reaching the site. Consider testing one Spanish creative to capture that demand cheaply.

recommendations.title: Add call tracking to Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: 122 call clicks this period is your strongest local signal. Worth tracking call outcomes so you know which reviews and photos actually drive booked consults.

recommendations.title: Repurpose 5-star reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: With 74 new reviews averaging 5.0 stars, consider testing a review-quote static ad against the current "GRT - Static" creative to lift trust and lower cost per lead.
